rea.scope: Static analysis of original proprietary artist card, follow hook, header and Library binding. No Chromium decompilation.

originalCard.artist: The sidebar uses the first artist contributor. Missing name or biography omits the section.
originalCard.visual: Original NPVArtistAboutV2 chooses the first landscape gallery group; otherwise it uses an avatar or fallback. The image header carries About the artist, with artist name, monthly listeners, a small follow button and a three-line biography below.
originalCard.follow: Original module568 reads LibraryAPI membership. Module19787 routes artists to LibraryAPI add/remove. Original Library routing gP/gL uses CollectionService Add/Remove for artist URIs even with Liked Songs list platform enabled.
css: .WMHj4_70SHCDap3tyQQs wraps the listener/follow row with an 8px gap

independentExecution.scope: Unchanged original Library add/remove routing, URI parser, collection client and protobuf encoder execute. Gallery/avatar selection executes unchanged. No account, network, native CollectionService backend or native HTTP WRITE producer executes.
substitutions: An inert Esperanto transport captures calls and returns an empty success response.
A new export exposes the original CollectionService client without changing its constructor or methods.
The original bundled protobufjs runtime executes as a standard primitive. A synthetic artist URI is the only entity input.

nativeWrite.contract: POST collection/v2/write, collection-v2 protobuf MIME for Accept and Content-Type. WriteRequest contains username, artist set, one CollectionItem and a 16-hex client_update_id. Removal sets is_removed. Original response owner acknowledges HTTP 200.
substitutions: Dart protobuf uses the original recovered descriptor.
System clock seconds supply the add/remove time; Random.secure supplies the update ID.
nativeWrite.scope: Native WRITE producer and response owner are retained static evidence. They were not independently executed by this experiment. The independently executed original renderer proves artist Add/Remove routing and bridge bytes; the live server check below proves admission and observed membership changes for this app session. Complete original native HTTP/wire parity is not claimed.

behavior: The visible sidebar loads one shared artist overview without popular-track or discography reads.
Artist route and sidebar share in-flight overview work and a bounded 16-entry, five-minute cache.
Membership reuses the artist Library snapshot. Acknowledged changes preserve added_at and invalidate only joined Library entries.
Only explicit follow clicks send writes. Unknown membership offers retry; rejected writes retain the last acknowledged state.
Card reads/writes and artwork retain caller cancellation. No clocks, polling or playback-position subscriptions are added.

live.environment: Isolated macOS debug probe restored a copy of the app-owned saved session through NativeDesktopRuntime; no playback engine was bound. The actual selected HTTP provider was preserved. The installed release kept running.
live.method: After each write, invalidate only the artist membership snapshot and read fresh server pages. Restore initial membership in finally.

cases: Artwork/header/name/listener count/biography render in the sidebar.
Follow and Following clicks toggle state and refresh Library.
A failed follow preserves Follow and shows the existing error snackbar.
The fixed sidebar header stays outside the scrolling card body.
flutter.scope: Layout and pointer checks use synthetic artist data and one local image. Live metadata and server membership checks are separate.

checks: 3 focused tests passed: native_followed_artists_test.dart and native_saved_tracks_test.dart.
Targeted analysis of the new and directly related owners/tests reports no issues.
The wider runtime/composition analysis retains existing unrelated lint warnings.

limits: Original native UI capture was unavailable because the REA host lacks Screen Recording and Accessibility grants. User-provided screenshots, retained renderer/CSS and original routine execution supplied the reference.
The card opens the existing artist route; the original expanded biography modal is not ported.
No installed release replacement or playback/licensing reliability claim is made.
